pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with moderate edge angularity and semi-diffuse pixel gradients. Relative spatial area of patches is largest on the upper neck and shoulder, decreasing toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative-space network with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pathways maintain consistent narrow pixel thickness and continuity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-profile mane is visible along the upper neck, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct vertical area of dark textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the mid-flank, spanning across several patch boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark marking on the mid-upper flank appears as a localized deviation from the surrounding pelage pattern, suggesting a lesion or significant textural anomaly.
